description: dnshub overview: RED method (Rate, Errors, Duration), cache performance, blocklist analytics, per-client policy decisions, tier failover, blocklist daemon health, DHCP leases, and DoT/DoH connections. Uses Prometheus for metrics and Loki for logs.

panels.description: DNS query rate (requests per second) across all clients and query types. Source: dnshub_queries_total.
panels.title: RED - Query Rate

panels.description: Error rate (errors per second) by error_type. Source: dnshub_errors_total.
panels.title: RED - Error Rate

panels.description: Upstream latency p95 (seconds) across all tiers. Source: dnshub_upstream_latency_seconds histogram.
panels.title: RED - Upstream Latency

panels.description: Cache hit ratio over time. Source: dnshub_cache_hit_ratio gauge (also derivable from dnshub_cache_hits_total / (hits + misses)).
panels.title: Cache - Hit Ratio

panels.description: Cache hit and miss rates over time. Sources: dnshub_cache_hits_total, dnshub_cache_misses_total.
panels.title: Cache - Hit / Miss Rate

panels.description: Current number of entries in the response cache. Source: dnshub_cache_size_entries gauge.
panels.title: Cache - Size (entries)

panels.description: Blocklist hits per second by category. Source: dnshub_blocklist_hits_total.
panels.title: Blocklist - Hits by Category

panels.description: Blocklist hits per second by source. Source: dnshub_blocklist_hits_total.
panels.title: Blocklist - Hits by Source

panels.description: Top blocked domains from dnshub logs (Loki LogQL). Shows the most frequently blocked domains in the selected time range.
panels.title: Blocklist - Top Blocked Domains (Loki)

panels.description: Query rate per client tag. Source: dnshub_queries_total grouped by client.
panels.title: Client - Queries by Profile

panels.description: Policy decisions per second by decision type (allowed, blocked, redirected). Source: dnshub_policy_decisions_total.
panels.title: Policy - Decisions by Type

panels.description: Active clients gauge. Source: dnshub_clients_active.
panels.title: Client - Active Clients

panels.description: Policy decisions broken down by profile. Source: dnshub_policy_decisions_total grouped by profile.
panels.title: Policy - Decisions by Profile

panels.description: Per-client error rate. Source: dnshub_errors_total grouped by client (when present).
panels.title: Client - Error Rate by Client

panels.description: Queries per second by tier. Source: dnshub_tier_queries_total.
panels.title: Tier - Queries per Tier

panels.description: Tier failure rate = failures / queries per tier. Sources: dnshub_tier_failures_total, dnshub_tier_queries_total.
panels.title: Tier - Failure Rate

panels.description: Upstream latency p95 per tier. Source: dnshub_upstream_latency_seconds histogram grouped by tier.
panels.title: Tier - Latency per Tier (p95)

panels.description: Tier failures by reason (timeout vs error). Source: dnshub_tier_failures_total grouped by reason.
panels.title: Tier - Failures by Reason

panels.description: Last successful blocklist refresh per source (Unix timestamp). Source: dnshub_blocklist_last_refresh_timestamp.
panels.title: Blocklist Health - Last Refresh Age

panels.description: Entry count per blocklist source. Source: dnshub_blocklist_entries_total gauge.
panels.title: Blocklist Health - Entry Count by Source

panels.description: Blocklist refresh status (success/failure) over time. Source: dnshub_blocklist_refresh_total grouped by status.
panels.title: Blocklist Health - Refresh Status

panels.description: Total active DHCP leases. Source: dnshub_dhcp_leases_active gauge.
panels.title: DHCP - Active Leases

panels.description: DHCP lease allocations and releases over time. Sources: dnshub_dhcp_leases_allocated_total, dnshub_dhcp_leases_released_total.
panels.title: DHCP - Lease Allocations / Releases

panels.description: Active DoT (DNS-over-TLS, port 853) connections. Source: dnshub_dot_connections_active gauge.
panels.title: DoT - Active Connections

panels.description: Active DoH (DNS-over-HTTPS, port 443) connections. Source: dnshub_doh_connections_active gauge.
panels.title: DoH - Active Connections

panels.description: DoT and DoH connection rate over time. Sources: dnshub_dot_connections_total, dnshub_doh_connections_total.
panels.title: DoT/DoH - Connection Rate

panels.description: Recent dnshub log lines from Loki. Filter on the job label matching the dnshub service.
panels.title: Logs - dnshub (Loki)

panels.description: Recent dnshub error and warning log lines from Loki.
panels.title: Logs - Errors & Warnings (Loki)
